executionObservedAtMissingReason: The original execution timestamp was not retained in the supplied run summary.
commandMissingReason: The exact original argv was not retained.
exitCodeMissingReason: The summary records the failed test but not its original process exit code.
observedFailure: Confirmation time was captured before asynchronous current-readiness refresh, so refreshed checkedAt could be later than the validation clock.
resolution: The service now captures confirmation time after loading refreshed authority and uses that same time for validation and TTL derivation.
